title: SAFE-Fire: code and frozen evaluation records

creators.name: Hade, Aya
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

creators.name: Kamil, Mustafa
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

description: Code, frozen evaluation records, trained weights and the records of every training run supporting a study of false alarm rates in indoor fire detection. Version 3.1.0 adds round 2 of the extended study: a visual audit of the mined negatives, a random control drawn from the mining corpus, a domestic negative set, 12 further training runs (63 in all), seed-pooled statistics with multiplicity adjustment, bootstrap intervals for mAP, in-domain D-Fire curves and video at 16 frames per second.
